newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Banks lead Estonian shares to higher, active close.
newsitem.headline: Banks lead Estonian shares to higher, active close.

text.p: The Tallinn bourse closed higher on Wednesday in heavy trade of 88 million kroons as major banks were boosted by merger and takeover talks, dealers said.
The Talse index gained 1.54 percent to 257.26.
Hoiupank was the most active stock with 35.56 million kroons traded to be 0.73 kroons higher at 133 kroons.

Dealers said some large blocks were behind Hoiupank's trade. They said the shares were boosted by news it was considering a merger with a local bank and has also said it will increase its profit forecast for 1997.
"The market believes that Hoiu is capable of a takeover," one dealer said.
Hansapank rose 3.35 kroons in trade of 21 million kroons and Forekspank, in which Hoiu said it was most interested, rose 2.5 kroons in trade of six million kroons.
A dealer said good May results from Hansa and Hoiu also supported the price. Tallinna, which posted worse than expected May results, fell by 0.45 kroons.
Dealers added that the heavy trade was exceptional and although it might be higher than usual tomorrow, it will probably slow down again.
The free market had a total trade of 8.8 million kroons.
